limitations: Experimental only; no public CPU promotion or calibrated probabilities.
Main model trained on a small no-sole-winner-only Value dataset; neither strength nor calibration established.
24 games across all four seats and both rule settings, one opening family per condition, 64-ply cap: all unfinished. No draws inferred and confidence intervals remain null.

Only 120 of 151 candidate turns in model matches completed model comparisons within 100ms; 31 used legal backup moves without a completed iteration. These are budget stops, not model-load/inference failures.
Time controls are cooperative; actual API wall time includes preparation/overruns. Native Python tensor operations may finish after consumer cancellation; request is drained and process reused.
One-ply terminal tactical tests have work/depth limits but no wall-clock limit. Linux model calls took over 600ms; passing does not establish a 500ms tactical guarantee.
Same-model 500ms/30s calls confirm budget reuse and deeper search only, not stronger play.
Measured locally on OrbStack Linux aarch64 with 2CPU/1GiB limits, not an actual VPS or x86_64. Long-duration/max-history/concurrency resource limits remain unverified.
Temporary model/data/report storage; long-term storage decision T05 and VPS selection/deployment T02 remain open.
